_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 09 관계사의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 6과 관계사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.point_label: 계속적 용법에는 that을 쓸 수 없다
questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: • The teacher ________ studied in Canada teaches here.
• I met my uncle, ________ lives in another country.

choices.text: who
that
which
what
whom

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 생략할 수 없는 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: The novel [[which]] I’m reading is thrilling.
Tell me the place [[where]] you’re working.
I want to know the reason [[why]] she quit.
This is a song [[that]] comforts many people.
Do you know the time [[when]] the show begins?

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: He didn’t agree with what she suggested.
She likes food that is grilled or steamed.
The muffins that I baked were delicious.
I often visit the shop whose owners are kind.
What I want from my teacher are her advice.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: I bought a pair of gloves, that were too big for me.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The program which has lots of violent scenes are not allowed for children.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 관계대명사가 나머지와 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: ________ surprised me was her honesty.
________ you were searching for is on the shelf.
Mina showed her dad ________ she drew in class.
Jiho achieved ________ he dreamed of after years.
I was busy answering the letters ________ I received during the holidays.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.
body: 나는 자전거를 고쳤는데, 그 자전거는 다시 고장 났다.

choices.text: I had fixed the bike, that broke again.
I had fixed the bike, what broke again.
The bike, that I had fixed, broke again.
I had fixed the bike, which broke again.
I had fixed the bike, in which broke again.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 우리가 지난여름에 묵었던 그 호텔에서 만나자.
(the hotel / stayed / where / last summer / we)
questions.answer: the hotel where we stayed last summer

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 자전거로 등교하는 많은 학생들이 있다.
(bikes / go to school / who / lots of / by / students)
questions.answer: lots of students who go to school by bikes

questions.point_label: the way와 how는 함께 쓰지 않는다
questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것을 모두 고르세요.
body: I’d like to know the way. Minho succeeded as a chef in that way.

choices.text: I’d like to know how Minho succeeded as a chef.
I’d like to know the way Minho succeeded as a chef.
I’d like to know the way how Minho succeeded as a chef.
I’d like to know the way what Minho succeeded as a chef.
I’d like to know the way which Minho succeeded as a chef.

questions.prompt: 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: My uncle gave me a scarf as a present, but I already had one.
→ My uncle gave me a scarf as a present, ________ ________ ________ ________.

questions.prompt: 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: The girl went to the lost and found. Her wallet was missing.
→ The girl ________ ________ ________ ________ went to the lost and found.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ I have a lot of scarves whose patterns are different.
ⓑ The woman to whom Sora is waving was her aunt.
ⓒ Mina is wearing the boots who her sister gave to her.
ⓓ Can you tell me the way you bake this delicious bread?
ⓔ Jiho explained the thing what happened yesterday to his parents.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: [[What]] do you want to do this weekend?
Don’t delay [[what]] you can finish today.
Try to choose [[what]] you really enjoy.
[[What]] Sora told me yesterday was a lie.
[[What]] I want to do is read under a tree.

body: 민지는 내가 매주 토요일에 도서관에 함께 가는 친구이다.
<조건> • 「전치사+관계대명사」의 형태를 사용할 것  • the friend, I, go to the library를 사용하여 아홉 단어로 쓸 것
→ Minji is ________________ every Saturday.
questions.answer: the friend with whom I go to the library
